scientific_integrity: Acyclic face matching and signed integral Morse differentials are exhaustively verified by an embedded deterministic checker, with independently reconstructed mod-two homology; no external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite computation applies only to the 25-vertex stable Kneser/Schrijver graph SG(4,2), not to the entire graph family or to the distinct Lovasz neighborhood complex. No unindexed-priority guarantee.
title: Simple-homotopy reduction of the twenty-five-vertex Schrijver independence complex
